hypotheses.title: Calibrated 3-Day Volatility-Normalized Microstructure Counterweight on Inverted model16
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 229, Candidate 1 achieved Sharpe 1.23, Fitness 0.98, and Sub-universe Sharpe 0.78 with 8.52% turnover. Turnover was slightly sub-optimal (< 12%), causing lingering holding of post-catalyst fundamental positions. Increasing the microstructure counterweight from 0.15 to 0.25 and accelerating to a 3-day price delta normalized via group_zscore directly penalizes rapid short-term price overshoots. This is projected to lift turnover from 8.5% into the 12-16% sweet spot, unlocking Sharpe > 1.35 and Fitness > 1.50.
confounders: High intraday market-wide volatility spikes that distort 3-day z-scores across subindustries
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 3-day z-score counterweight increases turnover beyond 35% or degrades Sub-universe Sharpe below 0.50.

hypotheses.title: Quiet Institutional Accumulation: Inverted model16 with Volume Exhaustion Interaction
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Institutions quietly accumulate shares in firms undergoing operational efficiency upgrades and positive analyst revisions during low-volume consolidation windows. Interacting the inverted model16 composite with volume exhaustion (1 - group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)) concentrates exposure in neglected quality upgrades, while the 5-day delta mean-reversion counterweight suppresses momentum chasing.
confounders: Illiquid microcap stocks dominating the low-volume rank within subindustries
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if low-volume interaction leads to extreme concentration or negative returns during market drawdowns.

candidates.expression: group_rank(-cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative - analyst_revision_rank_derivative, subindustry) * (1 - group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Cross-Dataset Synergy: Inverted model16 Quality and Capital Discipline Return on Assets
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines two proven uncorrelated alpha sources: inverted cashflow efficiency and balance-sheet scaled capital discipline (-capex / assets, which achieved Sharpe 1.15 and 0.00 correlation in Batch 226). Firms with rising operational margins and low capital expenditure intensity generate superior unencumbered free cash flow. A 4-day price mean-reversion term ensures continuous agile rebalancing and optimal 14-18% turnover.
confounders: Cyclical industries where capex requirements precede revenue realization by multiple quarters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if capex discipline fails to add orthogonal information to model16 efficiency.

candidates.expression: 0.45 * group_rank(-cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, subindustry) + 0.35 * group_rank(-ts_backfill(capex, 60) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), subindustry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 4) / close, subindustry)
